reviews.title: Hugely disappointed
reviews.body:
Hugely disappointed, i ordered the iphone duo on preorder and had it confirmed that deliver was as soon as iPhone was released on the 22nd (expect delivery next day)
I call on Saturday to be told the delivery had arrived and just needed checking into the warehouse today (monday 26th) i would then get next day delivery. I call again today (26th) and was told phones won’t be in until at least 7th november. It seems i get a differant story each time i call. 
Looking like i will cancel my order alltogether and get a refund and buy it elsewhere with a more reliable company. 
My advise is stick with Lebara for data but steer clear if you’re buying a new handset. 
Very disappointing service.

reviews.title: Roaming services paid for did not work. Poor and ineffective customer services
reviews.body:
I chose Lebara because of its advertised claims to provide cheap and reliable additional roaming services packafes (calls, texts, access to internet) when travelling abroad outside the EU. In reality   the additional services/packages  i then paid Lebara for  (via sims and also esims) repeatedly did not work. This left me unable to arrange accommodation i needed and also I was often unable to access my finances while i was abroad (eg, i was unable to use my phone to make or receive calls/texts/emails  etc to/from various organisations i needed to , including my banks and also airbnb and other accommodation providers) via my phone or laptop. I had to instead resort to finding and using internet cafes, etc which was much more inconvenient and involved additional costs being incurred and the time spent/disruption to plans involved in doing this. Lebara customer services were extremely ineffective/useless when i raised this with them , and repeatedly failed to resolve these issues , despite me spending significant additional time and money trying to arrange this. The costs i incurred buying the addtional sim and esim packages which did not work were not refunded. The  barriers /lack of help put in place by lebara led to me  abandoning pursuing this further. 

Additionally, when i subsequently contacted lebara to get a PAC to move to another provider i was repeatedly contacted by Lebara staff by phone and email pestering me to stay, despite me asking them to stop contacting me further.
